prompt: Evaluate whether the evalkit plugin's commit-helper skill improves the task "add input validation to the signup form". The skill is installed as a plugin, not committed in the repo.
setup: The skill under test belongs to an installed plugin under the host's shared config dir (not a file in the repo tree).
The plugin is enabled via an enabledPlugins entry in the user-scope settings file.
The working tree is clean and on a committed base.
The target repo's .gitignore does not mention any host settings file.
expected: The skill is classified as a plugin skill, so isolation pins enablement instead of deleting a file.
Each arm pins enabledPlugins to true in the with arm and false in the without arm.
On Claude Code the pin is written outside the worktree and passed to the headless session with --settings, leaving no settings file inside the repo.

On Copilot CLI, which has no out-of-tree settings flag, the pin is written into the worktree, excluded from staging with a git add pathspec exclusion, and followed by a pin-leak check against the captured diff.
The per-arm fired-check confirms the skill fired in the with arm and did not fire in the without arm.
The captured diff for each arm contains no settings pin, so the arm-blind reviewer cannot infer the arm and files_changed is not inflated.
must_not: Delete or edit the shared plugin install under the user config dir.
Copy or mutate HOME in place for the parallel arm.
Report an attributable result if the without arm still shows the skill fired.
Proceed when the plugin's files are not installed or a managed scope force-enables it.
Assume the settings pin is gitignored by the target repo.
Write the pin into the worktree on Claude Code when --settings can keep it outside the repo entirely.
Report a result from an arm whose captured diff contains the settings pin, since that diff reveals the arm label to the reviewer.
